title: Describe Cooperation Like a Commentator | Parenting Rewind
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: During dinner preparation, small cooperative actions can pass unnoticed because the parent is focused on finishing the meal. Waiting for perfect teamwork means missing the useful steps happening in front of you. Pause and describe one action in plain language, like a calm sports commentator. Say: You placed the napkins beside each plate while your sister stirred; both jobs are helping the table get ready. Description shows attention without exaggeration and gives children clear language for the contribution they just made.
